obligation_scope_target.name: obligation_scope_target
obligation_scope_target.value:
("app"."obligation"."scope" <> 'vehicle' or "app"."obligation"."vehicle_id" is not null)
        and ("app"."obligation"."scope" <> 'venue' or "app"."obligation"."venue_id" is not null)

obligation_intervals.name: obligation_intervals
obligation_intervals.value:
("app"."obligation"."interval_months" is null or "app"."obligation"."interval_months" > 0)
        and ("app"."obligation"."interval_km" is null or "app"."obligation"."interval_km" > 0)
        and "app"."obligation"."lead_days" >= 0

installment_paid.name: installment_paid
installment_paid.value:
"app"."installment"."status" in ('open', 'cancelled')
        or ("app"."installment"."paid_on" is not null and "app"."installment"."paid_amount_cents" is not null and "app"."installment"."paid_amount_cents" >= 0)

payable_scope_target.name: payable_scope_target
payable_scope_target.value:
("app"."payable"."scope" <> 'event' or "app"."payable"."event_id" is not null)
        and ("app"."payable"."scope" <> 'vehicle' or "app"."payable"."vehicle_id" is not null)
        and ("app"."payable"."scope" <> 'venue_season' or ("app"."payable"."venue_id" is not null and "app"."payable"."season" is not null))

permit_validity.name: permit_validity
permit_validity.value: "app"."permit"."valid_from" is null or "app"."permit"."valid_until" is null or "app"."permit"."valid_until" >= "app"."permit"."valid_from"

permit_requirement_month_days.name: permit_requirement_month_days
permit_requirement_month_days.value:
("app"."permit_requirement"."submission_window_start_md" is null or "app"."permit_requirement"."submission_window_start_md" ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$')
        and ("app"."permit_requirement"."submission_window_end_md" is null or "app"."permit_requirement"."submission_window_end_md" ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$')
        and ("app"."permit_requirement"."expected_decision_md" is null or "app"."permit_requirement"."expected_decision_md" ~ '^(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$')

employment_contract_amounts.name: employment_contract_amounts
employment_contract_amounts.value:
("app"."employment_contract"."hourly_rate_cents" is null or "app"."employment_contract"."hourly_rate_cents" > 0)
        and ("app"."employment_contract"."fixed_monthly_pay_cents" is null or "app"."employment_contract"."fixed_monthly_pay_cents" >= 0)
        and ("app"."employment_contract"."contracted_hours_per_week" is null or "app"."employment_contract"."contracted_hours_per_week" >= 0)

payroll_period_status_dates.name: payroll_period_status_dates
payroll_period_status_dates.value:
("app"."payroll_period"."status" = 'open' or "app"."payroll_period"."locked_at" is not null)
        and ("app"."payroll_period"."status" not in ('approved', 'exported') or "app"."payroll_period"."approved_at" is not null)
        and ("app"."payroll_period"."status" <> 'exported' or "app"."payroll_period"."exported_at" is not null)

checklist_one_owner.name: checklist_one_owner
checklist_one_owner.value: not ("app"."checklist"."event_id" is not null and "app"."checklist"."permit_id" is not null)
